IMSLP: strings, 6 movements, 1754; BIS 'Complete Early Divertimenti' (Deezer) titles it 'a 5', six movements totalling 18.8 min. One-to-a-part claim rests on the BIS booklet (not re-opened). Shares the aka 'Divertimento a cinque' with Hob. II:1 (101999), a different work.
Accent disc: P. 98, six movements, 20.1 min. Doblinger edition and CD booklet: principal oboe (flute in the Lambach parts), viola, violone, Salzburg 1772; IMSLP says 'before 1772'.

cpo (Salzburger Hofmusik, 2000) titles it 'P. 99, MH 27', four movements, 20.2 min; Brilliant 96127 review also names MH 27. Accent disc mislabels the same piece 'P. 110'. IMSLP avg 25-30 min vs recordings 19-20: 20 kept. IMSLP dates it 1758-60?, Allmusic 1764-70: c. 1760 fine.

IMSLP: 2 violins, viola, double bass, 1782, 24 min, five movements opening with the march. cpo (Salzburger Hofmusik) plays it in 23.8 min, Linz CO 23.6, Meridian 28. Cello substitute is from a contemporary copy and Upmeyer's 1928 edition, not the autograph.

IMSLP: MH deest, 2 movements, 'very possibly spurious'; Doblinger DM 586 prints it under his name; Da Vinci Classics disc plays Andante + Tempo di menuetto (8 min). Doubtful-attribution rule met (published and recorded under his name).

Year unresolved: the Budapest parts (Ms. Mus. 2508) are dated Salzburg 8 June [1]790, but the Rettensteiner and Lang catalogues (Doblinger preface) and Sherman-Thomas via IMSLP give 3 Aug 1795. Scoring (English horn, violin, cello, violone) and 3 movements confirmed; recordings 13-16 min, 14 stands.

MH 308: movements (Andante commodo, Menuetto, Rondo) and timings match the Constanze (cpo 2024) and Sonare (Claves 1988) recordings; Wikipedia marks MH 308-313 authenticity disputed; IMSLP calls them a set of six, c. 1780?. Not on IMSLP.

MH 309: movements (Andante, Menuetto, Allegretto) and timings match the Constanze (cpo 2024) and Sonare (Claves 1988) recordings; Wikipedia marks MH 308-313 authenticity disputed; IMSLP calls them a set of six, c. 1780?. Not on IMSLP.

MH 311: movements (Andante un poco allegro, Andante grazioso, Menuetto with variations) and timings match the Constanze (cpo 2024) and Sonare (Claves 1988) recordings; Wikipedia marks MH 308-313 authenticity disputed; IMSLP calls them a set of six, c. 1780?. Not on IMSLP.

MH 312: movements (four movements ending Finale. Allegro) and timings match the Constanze (cpo 2024) and Sonare (Claves 1988) recordings; Wikipedia marks MH 308-313 authenticity disputed; IMSLP calls them a set of six, c. 1780?. Not on IMSLP.

MH 313: movements (Andante, Menuetto, Finale) and timings match the Constanze (cpo 2024) and Sonare (Claves 1988) recordings; Wikipedia marks MH 308-313 authenticity disputed; IMSLP calls them a set of six, c. 1780?. Not on IMSLP.
cpo complete quintets: MH 189 = P. 109, four movements, 27.5 min (Adagio affettuoso 12.9 min).
cpo complete quintets: MH 367 = P. 110, Allegro moderato, Menuetto, Adagio, Finale. Presto, 22.4 min.

MusicWeb: Op. 69 (1977), one movement, 14 min, premiered by the Leonardo Trio 2 Nov 1978, Radio 3 broadcasts. IMSLP 14 min. No commercial recording found; floor rests on edition (Westfield Music) plus documented professional performances.

MusicWeb: Op. 99 (1985), flute, cello, piano, premiered Southampton 16 Nov 1985 (Butt, Pople, Wright), Radio 3 broadcast; IMSLP 16 min, 3 movements. No commercial recording found; floor rests on edition plus documented performances.

MusicWeb: Op. 106 (1987), clarinet and string quartet, 'just under 15 minutes' (IMSLP 16), premiered 15 Jun 1988 by James Campbell and the Allegri Quartet. No commercial recording found; floor rests on edition plus documented premiere.

fixes.notes: Three movements; published 1923 by Schirmer for the Society for the Promotion of American Music

results.note: The Albany disc holds two pieces both labelled 'Piano Trio in C, Op. 7'. Heilman's is tracks 1-3 (Allegro amabile, Poco adagio, Allegro grazioso, as in IMSLP's movement list) = 22.5 min; the researcher added the other three tracks (Allegro con fuoco, Largo, Allegro ma non troppo; 15 min) to reach 38. IMSLP says 22. Key C minor per IMSLP. Notes rewritten.
IMSLP: oboe, viola da gamba, continuo, 4 movements (SeiH 254). Carus 'Pisendel & Dresden' plays Adagio, Andante, Affetuoso, Allegro in 7.0 min.
Dacapo complete quartets (Nordic String Quartet, Deezer): No. 1 runs 23.8 min; Allegro, Larghetto, Scherzo (Prestissimo), Allegro vivace.
Dacapo complete quartets (Nordic String Quartet, Deezer): No. 5 runs 35.6 min; finale Adagio quasi fantasia 16.2 min.
Dacapo complete quartets (Nordic String Quartet, Deezer): No. 6 runs 29.8 min; Largo introduction; finale Andante sostenuto - Allegro molto.
Dacapo 2016 disc: four movements, 27.0 min; IMSLP 1917?, published 1922, 25 min, 'No. 4' in the DKB catalogue.
Tre Musici (Dacapo): three movements, 18.5 min; IMSLP 19 min, G major, composed 1904 (Dutch Royal Library), published 1909.
Arditti/Wergo (Deezer) No. 1: 19.0 min; four movements Allegro molto, Andantino, Lento, Presto; 1947 (de.wikipedia work list).
Arditti/Wergo (Deezer) No. 2: 14.9 min; three movements marked by metronome; 1952 (de.wikipedia work list).
Arditti/Wergo (Deezer) No. 3: 19.0 min; one movement; premiered 12 Sep 1976 Berlin (Concord Quartet) (de.wikipedia work list).
Arditti/Wergo (Deezer) No. 4: 35.2 min; four movements, Adagio incl. Byrd pavan, Rondo improvvisato; 1976 (de.wikipedia work list).
Arditti/Wergo (Deezer) No. 5: 25.5 min; six movements ending Morgenlied; 1976 (de.wikipedia work list).
de.wikipedia: 'Adagio adagio' (1993), Serenade for piano trio, premiered 18 Mar 1993 Schloss Wolfsgarten (Menuhin, Gorokhov, Mulligan). Daniel Hope (DG) 4.3 min, ensemble recherche (Wergo) 4.0 min.
Bassoon, guitar and string trio, seven movements, 14.0 min on both recordings (Scharoun Ensemble/Tudor; Villa Musica); de.wikipedia: 1996, 'freely after' the music theatre piece Oedipus der Tyrann.

Villa Musica disc: 'Selbst- und Zwiegespräche, a Trio for Viola, Guitar and Organ' 6.9 min; de.wikipedia: 1984/85, viola, guitar and small organ (or other keyboard); formation 'other' is what formationFor derives.

de.wikipedia: Fantasia for string sextet (3 violins, 2 violas, cello), 1966, premiered 1968 (Langbein Ensemble), five movements; Villa Musica plays four (Adagio, Allegro marcato, Air, Vivace) in 15.8 min.

1948 (rev. 1963), premiered Cologne 16 Mar 1950. Both recordings (Trio Aquilon 10.0 min, Baird Trio 13.1 min) play five movements; de.wikipedia lists three movements for the original version, so 'five-movement' describes the revision.
ensemble recherche (Wergo): three movements, 24.2 min; de.wikipedia: 1998, premiered 12 May 1999 Schwetzingen.

Chandos 2025 (Kaleidoscope Chamber Collective): Op. 9 'Im Sommer', four movements, 24 min, second is 'Fliegen und Schmetterlinge'. Wikipedia dates it 1883 (not added: source unclear); year left blank.
Chandos 2025: 'Piano Quartet No. 3 in C Minor, Op. 60 "Werther"', four movements, 35.2 min. Wikipedia dates No. 3 1879 (opus link unclear); year left blank.
Hermann's one-movement trio of 1921 is the disc's first track (8.5 min); the disc's four-movement 'String Trio (1921)' is Zoltan Szekely's, so do not use it for Hermann. IMSLP 7.5-10 min.

Quatuor Girard (Paraty 2018): single track 19.1 min, 'The Starry Sky'. Web search: premiered April 2015 by the Cypress Quartet (San Francisco), so composed c. 2014-15; year left blank. Only one recording found.
IMSLP: 2 violins, viola da gamba, continuo, published 1662. Hamburger Ratsmusik (NCA 2005) track 'La Chilana a3 in D Major, ICH 1' 5.4 min.
cpo 777 083-2 (Minguet Quartett, 2009): four movements 34.3 min; IMSLP: 2 violins, 2 violas, cello, published Rieter-Biedermann 1892.

Naxos (Meyers, Weilerstein, Neiman): two movements Pale Yellow / Fiery Red, 13.3 min; Wikipedia list: Piano Trio (2003); her second trio 'Color Through' (2016) is a different work and not in the catalogue.
Naxos 'Early Chamber Works' (Serafin Quartet): 'Amazing Grace (Version for string quartet)', 4.6 min. Higdon has other scorings of the hymn (flute list); only the quartet version is here.
Naxos (Serafin Quartet): four movements, 21.3 min.

note: Haydn Hob. V:C1-C5/G4/A2 rest on the Camerata Tokyo set listing (vols 5-6 not on streaming; C1 and A2 also in modern editions); attribution doubtful. Hedges trios pass the floor only through documented performances, no commercial recording found. MH 600 year (1790 vs 1795) unresolved.
